title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #102 · 블루블랙·검정 배경 고정 명화 믹스 · 가로 띠·물결 · 6영역(뭉크+미로+무하+로스코+호쿠사이+폴록) · curvy petite · 와이드 스탠스·주먹 힙 · 블루블랙 · 배경 검정 스튜디오 · 메이크업 없음(블루블랙)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her body is painted in 6 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 6 horizontal bands by 5 hazy transition zones centred about 9% of the way down her figure from the top, about 25% of the way down her figure from the top, about 39% of the way down her figure from the top, about 51% of the way down her figure from the top and about 79% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries Munch The Scream style flowing wavy bands of blood-orange, blue and black swirling over her curves. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Miro style playful biomorphic shapes, stars and curling black lines on flat primary colour fields. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Mucha style Art Nouveau flowing floral curves with soft pastel flowers and ornamental whiplash lines. Region 4 is the band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries Rothko style colour fields, soft-edged stacked rectangles of deep crimson, orange and maroon glowing like light. Region 5 is the band between transition zone 4 and transition zone 5: it carries Hokusai Great Wave style, rolling indigo waves with white foam claws and bold black linework. Region 6 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries Jackson Pollock style action painting, tangled drips and splatters of black, white, orange and teal flung across her skin. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living blue-black skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform stiletto heels of real glossy patent leather, each in a main colour of whichever painting that leg falls in, and extra long nails each polished in a main colour of whichever painting that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every brush stroke and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — every inch from neck to ankle filled with painting. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
